mapper.sql: menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, query, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id inner join sys_role r on rm.role_id = r.role_id inner join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
select menu_id from sys_role_menu where role_id = #{roleId}
